entities.name: Grand Coliseum
entities.description: Cabal-run arena on Coliseum Island in the swamps outside Aphetto on Otaria.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Black-aligned organization that ran the coliseum.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: Oversaw coliseum construction and fought there.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: Fought alongside Phage in the arena.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: Lost her legs fighting Kamahl, sparking the Nightmare War.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: Arrived looking for Kuberr and annihilated the coliseum.

entities.name: Lowallyn
entities.description: Escaped through a portal with Kuberr and Kamahl.

entities.name: The First
entities.description: Wanted Phage killed after she became pregnant.

events.summary: After Cabal City's destruction, the Cabal Patriarch has a new coliseum built near Aphetto under Phage's oversight.
events.quote: the Cabal Patriarch organized the construction of a new, even larger coliseum near Aphetto .

events.summary: Phage and Braids fight together in the arena against the slaves who built it.
events.quote: Phage and Braids fought together in the arena against the very same slaves that had built the structure.

events.summary: Kamahl defeats Phage and Akroma in a three-way battle; Akroma loses her legs, sparking the Nightmare War.
events.quote: ending with a victory for Kamahl and Akroma losing her legs, sparking off the Nightmare War .

events.summary: The First has Phage fight Umbra, Sash and Waistcoat; she defeats them though they are immune to her touch.
events.quote: She defeated the unmen and their minions, though being inorganic, they were immune to her deadly touch.

events.summary: Karona drains the area of mana, collapsing the arena and then annihilating the coliseum after Kuberr, Kamahl and Lowallyn escape.
events.quote: Karona proceeded to annihilate the rest of the coliseum in a rage, leaving nothing but a field of ashes behind.

relations.quote: The Grand Coliseum was a major attraction on Otaria run by the Cabal .
Phage and Braids fought together in the arena
ending with a victory for Kamahl and Akroma losing her legs
